name: Wuhu Token Sciences Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuhu Token Sciences Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of key basic materials and devices in flat panel display devices in China and internationally. It offers thin display panel products, including ultra-thin glass, OLED panel thinning, and TFT-LCD display glass thinning products; touch modules comprising vehicle touch modules, touch sensors, and industrial medical touch modules; and photoelectric materials, such as conductive glasses, color film, ITO coating, AR/IM coating, and other coated products, as well as display modules and automotive module displays. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Wuhu, China.
